items.title: Microsoft-Decision-1, our model for fast decision-making
items.summary: Microsoft released Microsoft-Decision-1, a model built specifically for fast decision-making rather than general chat or coding. (1 minute read)

items.title: Nvidia in talks to acquire open-model startup Reflection AI
items.summary: Nvidia is in talks to acquire Reflection AI, an open-weight model startup, according to the Financial Times. (1 minute read)

items.title: Tom Brown used GOP ties to broker a $1.25B/month SpaceX compute deal
items.summary: Anthropic's Tom Brown used Republican political connections to arrange a $1.25B-per-month compute deal with SpaceX, the Wall Street Journal reports. (1 minute read)

items.title: Strands Decider: a pointer-head model for agent decisions
items.summary: Strands Decider swaps a language model's output head for a ~1M-parameter pointer head, so one forward pass scores answer options instead of generating text. It reports 95%+ accuracy when confidence hits 0.9+ on JevBench's 231 tasks, answering in a median 115ms on an RTX 3090. Gemma 4 variants from 2B to 26B-A4B and a vision mode are also included. (2 minute read)

items.title: Terence Tao on Lean theorem prover reliability and AI
items.summary: Terence Tao lays out what mathematicians need to understand about the reliability of the Lean theorem prover when AI tools help construct or check proofs. (1 minute read)

items.title: Talorys runs a personal AI agent entirely on Cloudflare's free tier
items.summary: Talorys deploys a single-user AI agent using only Cloudflare Pages, Workers, one Durable Object with SQLite, and Workers AI, skipping paid services like R2 or D1 entirely. Durable Object alarms replace an always-on process, and chat runs on @cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash, streamed as SSE. A one-command installer (npx create-talorys@latest) deploys it with no telemetry. (2 minute read)

items.title: AI data centers admit they aren't covering their full costs
items.summary: AI data center companies told Senators Warren, Blumenthal, and Van Hollen they aren't covering their full infrastructure costs and will keep relying on NDAs and seeking tax breaks. (1 minute read)

items.title: Asana cuts model costs 76x switching to GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: Asana reports a 76x reduction in model costs during browser-agent tests after switching to GPT-6.1 Sol, per OpenAI's case study. (1 minute read)
